Parent pricing register and provisional quantities

Fictional test correspondence. All people, addresses, decisions and project particulars in this document are invented for a software evaluation.

Record R303 Date 2026-10-05 Email reply

From: Fictional Quantity Surveyor <qs@consense-scenario.invalid>
To: Fictional Coordination Team <team@consense-scenario.invalid>

The adopted pricing scheme combines Bills of Quantities and Schedules of Rates. The following seven entries are the complete parent pricing register. A number is local to its pricing document: BQ Bill 1 and SOR Bill 1 are separate entries, as are BQ Bill 2 and SOR Bill 2. Preserve the titles as issued.

Pricing document | Bill number | Issued Bill title

SOR | 1 | Ventilation and Cooling Systems

BQ | 1 | Contract Preliminaries

BQ | 2 | General Preambles

SOR | 2 | Lifts

BQ | 3 | Marine Training Centre and Staff Quarters

SOR | 3 | Fire Services Installations

BQ | 4 | Foundations and Coastal External Works (Partly Provisional)

Only the coastal external works identified within BQ Bill 4 have provisional quantities. The building and foundation quantities elsewhere are measured quantities. It is not the case that all BQ quantities are provisional.

Regards,
Fictional Quantity Surveyor

Section boundaries possession and weather terms

Fictional test correspondence. All people, addresses, decisions and project particulars in this document are invented for a software evaluation.

Record R312 Date 2026-10-16 Meeting minutes

Attendees: Fictional Project Architect, Structural Engineer, Procurement Officer and Quantity Surveyor. Recorder: Fictional Quantity Surveyor.

The complete Section schedule is below. All three Sections lie within one common fenced site. The small hut is a detached structure inside that site; there is no separate demolition site.

Site location | Section designation | Works types

Obsolete watch hut beside the south gate within the common fenced site | Section D | demolition

Staff quarters on the east side of the common fenced site | Section R | building, foundation

Marine training centre on the west side of the common fenced site | Section M | building, foundation

For the whole project, building and demolition works use that common site. The building and demolition sites are not separated. The detached condition of the watch hut is a description of a structure, not a separate project site.

Apply the standard GCC weather extension of time provisions. Neither optional SCC8.302 nor SCC8.303 is adopted. No demolition only Section insertion under SCC8.303 is needed.

Do not adopt the optional late possession provision. Adopt the additional loss provision, with Section M and Section R as its specified Sections. Its relevant Section is Section M.

Adopt advance payment under SCC14.305. Its repayment period is seventeen months. Deduct the first repayment instalment in the third interim payment certificate. The 17 months and the third certificate describe advance repayment; the whole contract completion period agreed earlier remains 39 months.
